The first Muslim attack on Orugallu took place in which year?
x:
The first Muslim attack on Orugallu (Warangal) took place in 1303 CE during the reign of Kakatiya Prataparudra II. Although this initial expedition was unsuccessful, it marked the beginning of repeated invasions by the Delhi Sultanate. Later campaigns by Malik Kafur (1309–10) and Ulugh Khan (1323) ultimately resulted in the fall of the Kakatiya kingdom.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).
n: First Muslim Attack on Warangal – 1303 CE

s: "Prataparudra Yasobhushanam" was written by?
x:
Vidyanatha, the distinguished court poet of Prataparudra II, authored the Sanskrit work Prataparudra Yasobhushanam. The work is an important treatise on poetics (Alankara Shastra) and praises the achievements of the Kakatiya ruler Prataparudra II.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
